cause: Opening radial enlargement was incorrectly applied around the remote cuff centre throughout the lower sleeve; it amplified the source taper into a bell. Fix restricts this added radial scale to the last 45mm while preserving the original sewn forearm.
measurement: Actual Babylon skinning matrices, idle to wave, both LODs, original skin opening and CG forearm reference; radius projected perpendicular to the posed elbow bone axis. Structural geometry proof, not a substitute for live GPU visual QA or an FPS benchmark.

finalGpuReview.result: Giant bell forearm distortion removed against same-angle previous PNG; small outward cuff lip remains a qualitative styling limitation. Not an AAA/perfect or FPS claim.
